truth_rule: Nothing is COMPLETE unless implementation + automated test + required real-machine or real-tool evidence exist for a specified supported configuration.

architecture_and_governance_baseline.note: documentation and policy consistency are tested; this is not a claim that the full AERIS company is verified

100_role_registry.note: role names/capability seats are not equivalent to 100 mature engineers

100_role_executable_contracts.required: per-role role contract + skills + methods + tool permissions + required evidence + golden/negative/regression tests + acceptance rubric + independent review

local_model_router.note: real local inference remains machine-scoped until local acceptance passes

cloud_public_research_router.note: current implementation is OpenAI-compatible; each real provider/model still needs live interoperability and license/policy validation

application_privacy_boundary.note: does not prove that every process on the OS can never leak data

cloud_secret_file_support.required: PR CI must pass tests/test_config.py before promotion to TESTED

os_network_egress_enforcement.required: machine-specific firewall/DLP/process isolation configuration + independent outbound validation

public_ingress_ssrf_and_dns_rebinding_gu.required: PR CI must pass ingress security tests; live HTTPS interoperability must still be validated on a real network

public_ingress_quarantine_and_human_prom.required: PR CI + real-machine scanner/path acceptance before VERIFIED

public_ingress_malware_scanning.required: requires an available local scanner such as Microsoft Defender or ClamAV; scanner-specific real-machine acceptance

local_knowledge_sqlite.note: basic local text index only; future PR adds stale cleanup/FTS hardening and must pass CI before its added claims are promoted

comsol_adapter.required: licensed COMSOL installation + exact-version API adapter + E2E model run + provenance/evidence

matlab_adapter.required: licensed MATLAB installation + compatible Engine/API + E2E script + provenance/evidence

apx_adapter.required: APx software/hardware/license/calibration + exact-version adapter + E2E measurement evidence

klippel_adapter.required: KLIPPEL software/hardware/license/calibration + supported automation module + E2E measurement evidence

soundcheck_adapter.required: SoundCheck installation/license + supported Python/TCP integration + E2E measurement evidence

acqua_adapter.required: HEAD/ACQUA licensed environment + exact supported automation interface + E2E evidence

supported_machine_profile_gate.required: PR CI + real-machine profile acceptance; a profile never equals VERIFIED

windows_linux_ci_kernel.note: VERIFIED only for the previously executed CI kernel scope, not the unmerged hardening branch or whole company

one_click_installer_smoke.note: CI smoke deliberately skips external local-AI installation

offline_staged_python_windows.required: fresh offline Windows machine evidence with checksum-verified staged installer

offline_staged_model_gguf.required: real Ollama staged GGUF import + inference evidence on each supported machine family

core_airgap_snapshot_integrity.required: PR CI must pass tests/test_corecache.py; destination local acceptance must run core verify

clean_windows_install.required: fresh-machine online and air-gap E2E evidence before VERIFIED

clean_linux_install.required: fresh-machine supported-distro online and air-gap E2E evidence before VERIFIED

jetson_orin_install.required: real Jetson E2E + memory + latency + thermal + reboot + offline evidence before VERIFIED

hard_offline_operation.required: network-isolated real inference + multi-path outbound probe block + OS firewall/process review; probe blocking is not a mathematical zero-egress proof

portable_software_image.note: existing verified scope predates SBOM/provenance hardening; new metadata remains pending PR CI

software_sbom_provenance.required: PR CI must validate SPDX 2.3 structure, provenance JSON and SHA256SUMS inside both package formats

encrypted_private_state_backup_restore.required: real age export + transfer + import + checksum + restore acceptance; archive hardening must pass PR CI

full_company_relocation.required: software image + encrypted private state + legal private asset pack + restore + tool/calibration + second-machine acceptance

commercial_release_readiness.required: all release-critical capabilities VERIFIED + model/tool/data licenses reviewed + supported configuration frozen + signed provenance/release policy
